mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested kitchen_table_k1 for early morning and armchair_l1 for evening, but day 30 data shows kitchen_table_k1 at 09:56 (late morning) and cupboard_k1 at 21:25 (late evening). The mug is not reliably at armchair_l1 or desk_o1. Check kitchen_table_k1 for morning/late morning (07:00-10:00); check cupboard_k1 for late evening (21:00+); coffee_table_l1 and desk_o1 are unreliable.

glass_tomas: Previous notes suggested cupboard_k1 for late night, but day 26 data showed kitchen_table_k1 (mid-day) and nightstand_b1 (late night). No new errors today, so keep existing pattern: check kitchen_table_k1 for mid-day and nightstand_b1 for late-night (22:00+); cupboard_k1 is unreliable.

book_tomas: Previous notes suggested bed_b1 for late night, contradicting an assumption of nightstand_b1. Day 30 22:32 miss (said bedroom_floor_b1, actually bed_b1) confirms the book stays at bed_b1 from late afternoon through the night. Check bed_b1 for all evening and late-night queries; drop bedroom_floor_b1 and nightstand_b1.

water_bottle_tomas: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for afternoon, but day 24 data showed desk_o1 (morning). Day 30 18:18 miss (said dining_table_d1, actually desk_o1) shows the bottle remains at desk_o1 into the late afternoon (18:00). Check desk_o1 for morning and late afternoon (18:00); dining_table_d1 for evening (19:00+); sink_k1 for late night.

charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for daytime, but day 24 data showed desk_o1 (morning). No new errors today, so keep existing pattern: check desk_o1 for morning (09:00-10:00); coffee_table_l1 for mid-day; nightstand_b1 for late night (22:00+).
